purpose: Test broader nonrare training coverage at fixed rare-row exposure, class sequence and neural work
selection_rule: All three seeds at fixed epoch 300; no best-epoch or best-seed selection
limits: Inherit small 64/32 LayerNorm MLP, dropout 0.2, Adam, loss, scaler, features, seeds 7/17/27 and 300-epoch budget
Every run processes 3045600 examples and 6000 updates; every class receives 380700 draws
Preserve exact rare training row identities and their positions in each batch, including repeats
Replace only the other six classes with draws from the existing 2M training cohort; all six change together
Match label and rare-row sequence hashes, initial parameters and work; record every training row exposure count
Control must reproduce historical learning curves, prefix and final parameters before any treatment training
Validation follows all six fits, and each control must reproduce its historical validation confusion matrix before treatment scoring
Report all eight class recalls, precisions and macro-F1 at raw argmax only; no new thresholds or loss changes
Validation is reused exploratory evidence, not independent confirmation; no final test, cloud use or production policy change
